words.example: One floor walker will remain in the lobby through the morning.
words.exampleZh: 整个上午都会有一名现场巡视员留在大厅。

words.example: Each clinic has named a super user for the new scheduling tool.
words.exampleZh: 每个门诊都为新的排班工具指定了一名业务骨干用户。

words.example: The night shift needs a champion who can explain the new form.
words.exampleZh: 夜班需要一位能把新表格讲清楚的推广骨干。

words.example: Our change agent will explain the new sign-in steps in every clinic.
words.exampleZh: 我们的变革推动者会到每个门诊讲解新的签到步骤。

words.example: The sponsor update comes first, right after everyone has sat down.
words.exampleZh: 大家落座之后，首先是发起人通报。

words.example: Smart-card logon failed at the pharmacy window because the reader cable was loose.
words.exampleZh: 药房窗口的智能卡登录失败了，读卡器的线是松的。

words.example: A burst of failed logon events hit the pharmacy account just after midnight.
words.exampleZh: 刚过午夜，药房账号上涌来一批登录失败事件。

words.example: The lockout policy trips after five bad passwords, which is why her account locked.
words.exampleZh: 锁定策略在五次错误密码后触发，所以她的账号被锁了。

words.example: We found her account disabled after she transferred out of the ward.
words.exampleZh: 她调离病区之后，我们发现账号已禁用。

words.example: We set account enabled again, and he can log on in the clinic.
words.exampleZh: 我们又把账号设成已启用，他在门诊可以登录了。
